ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with an approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous white field occupying the distal two-thirds of the left fluke lobe; dense black mottling and vertical banding patterns originating at the median notch and extending through the right fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Pronounced V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys isolated against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweep on both lobes, exhibiting an upward-tapering trajectory toward the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Set of distinct vertical dark pigment bars located in the lower central region of the fluke near the insertion point.
